name: Yuanyuan Hu
title: PhD Student, Cognitive Neuroscience
affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Cognitive Science and Mental Health, Institute of Psychology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
profile: I study how genetic and environmental influences shape brain networks and self-regulatory behavior, with a focus on procrastination, impulsivity, decision-making, and transdiagnostic mental-health risk. My work combines twin designs, neuroimaging, computational modeling, representational similarity analysis, and connectome-genetic approaches.
positioningOptions: Twin neuroimaging, behavioral genetics, and computational psychiatry of self-regulation and mental health.
Genetically informed neuroimaging of procrastination, impulsivity, and transdiagnostic psychopathology.
Computational and neurogenetic mechanisms linking decision-making, self-regulation, and mental health.
AI-augmented psychological measurement and computational psychiatry as an emerging secondary direction.

education.institution: Institute of Psychology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
education.detail: Using twin data to investigate the brain mechanisms through which genetic and environmental factors influence mental health.

Well trained in the theoretical frameworks and methodological approaches of clinical research on anxiety and depression.
